name: Elephant
appearance: A massive grey elephant with broad ears, long ivory tusks and a trunk that curls at the tip.
otherStatistics: Initiative -1 (9). Proficiency bonus +2. Passive Perception 10. No listed skill proficiencies or special senses. Languages none.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual for the 2024 rules, p. 353, published 2025. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775814-elephant
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Gore attacks.
Gore. Melee attack roll +8, reach 5 ft. Hit for 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the elephant moved at least 20 ft. straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target falls Prone.
sections.Bonus Actions: Trample. Choose one Prone creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. Failure deals 17 (2d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. Success halves the damage.

name: Elk
appearance: A tawny bull elk with long legs, a dark shaggy neck and a broad set of branching antlers.
otherStatistics: Initiative +0 (10). Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +2. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 12. Languages none.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual for the 2024 rules, p. 353, published 2025. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775815-elk
sections.Actions: Ram. Melee attack roll +5, reach 5 ft. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the elk moved at least 20 ft. straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target also takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage and falls Prone.

name: Frog
appearance: A squat olive-green frog with mottled skin, gold eyes and folded hind legs.
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +1, Stealth +3. Darkvision 30 ft. Passive Perception 11. Languages none.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual for the 2024 rules, p. 354, published 2025. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775816-frog
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The frog can breathe in air and underwater.
Standing Leap. Its Long Jump is up to 10 ft. and its High Jump is up to 5 ft. A running start is optional.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack roll +3, reach 5 ft. Hit for 1 Piercing damage.

name: Giant Ape
appearance: A huge gorilla-like ape with charcoal fur, a broad chest and muscular knuckle-walking arms.
otherStatistics: Initiative +5 (15). Proficiency bonus +3. Athletics +9, Perception +4, Survival +4. Passive Perception 14. No listed special senses. Languages none.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual for the 2024 rules, p. 354, published 2025. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195010-giant-ape
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fist attacks.
Fist. Melee attack roll +9, reach 10 ft. Hit for 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.
Boulder Toss (Recharge 6). Choose a visible point within 90 ft. Each creature in a 5-ft.-radius Sphere centered there makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, deal 24 (7d6) Bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature that fails also falls Prone. On a success, deal half damage only.
sections.Bonus Actions: Leap. Spend 10 ft. of movement to jump up to 30 ft.
sections.At the table: Once Boulder Toss is used, it becomes available again on a 6 on 1d6 at the start of a turn, or after a Short or Long Rest.

name: Giant Badger
appearance: A stocky shaggy badger with black-and-white facial stripes, broad paws and long digging claws.
otherStatistics: Initiative +0 (10). Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +3. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. Resistance to Poison damage. Languages none.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual for the 2024 rules, p. 354, published 2025. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775817-giant-badger
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack roll +3, reach 5 ft. Hit for 6 (2d4 + 1) Piercing damage.
